Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Nailhead Leather Recliner, 33"W, Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: stone
The simple, clean design of this recliner will blend with any style room. Top-grain leather on the entire chair, as well as nail head accents on the arms, add sophisticated touches. Substantial padding in the back cushion makes it extra welcoming. 32.6"W x 38.9"D x 39.7"H Top grain leather; nailhead trim; wood legs A simple style that blends with any room Plush cushioned back; push-back recliner with pop-up foot support Easy assembly in 15 minutes or less; just screw on legs Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
